title: Build and check a Compose service
task: Build and start api using Docker Compose. Wait for it to become healthy, then save the response from its published /health endpoint to health.txt.
hints: Wait for docker compose ps to show healthy and read the port mapping.
Use curl -fsS "http://$(docker compose port api 8080)/health" > health.txt.
